optimize_for_coreml: optimize an ONNX model for CoreML execution on Apple Silicon with optional fixed input shape
fold_shape_gather: fold Shape and Gather node chains into constants using ONNX shape inference for known input dimensions
decompose_reflect_pad: decompose reflect padding operations into Slice and Concat sequences that CoreML supports natively
decompose_split: decompose two-way channel-wise Split operations into Slice pairs for CoreML compatibility
rewrite_scalar_gather: rewrite scalar Gather indices to 1D tensors with Squeeze for CoreML EP compatibility
